name: Selenio Network Processor (SNP), 4 processors
notes: 1RU software-defined processor: 4 personalities (ST 2110 / 2022-6 gateway, up/down/cross, frame sync, multiviewer, JPEG XS) on 4 application processors (SNP-PLATFORM-2AU has 2, upgradable). 32 bidirectional HD-BNC SDI ports (8 are 12G), 2 x QSFP28 (100GbE), quad SFP+ cage for MADI, 3G coax or optical. Under 350 W, 594 mm deep, 7.5 kg. Check: which panel carries the management ports.

name: Platinum IP3 15RU router frame, up to 288 x 512
notes: 15RU hybrid SDI/IP router frame with 32 input and 32 output card slots, up to 288 x 512 in one frame. Takes Platinum SX Pro multiviewer cards (1 to 4 slots) and IP gateway cards. Magellan control via the PX-RES resource module. 2 x 1500 W PX-PS supplies standard. I/O sits on the cards, so add the signals as you wire it. Check: rear reference, control and power connectors.

name: Platinum IP3 28RU router frame, up to 576 x 1024
notes: 28RU hybrid SDI/IP router frame with 64 input and 64 output card slots, up to 576 x 1024 in one frame. Takes Platinum SX Pro multiviewer cards (1 to 4 slots) and IP gateway cards. Magellan control via the PX-RES resource module. 4 x 1500 W PX-PS supplies standard. I/O sits on the cards, so add the signals as you wire it. Check: rear reference, control and power connectors.
